judgments.reason: The dataset's DOI and authors (Aricò, Aloise, Schettini, Salinari, Mattia, Cincotti) match this paper on P300 latency jitter in overt and covert attention BCI, which is the study that reports this data.
judgments.paper_title: Influence of P300 latency jitter on event related potential-based brain–computer interface performance

judgments.reason: Dataset is the Aricò et al. 2014 P300 study of 10 healthy female participants; this paper studies attention and P300 BCI in 8 ALS patients, a different study on a similar topic.
judgments.paper_title: Attention and P300-based BCI performance in people with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis

judgments.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool for organizing electrophysiological data into BIDS, used in curating the dataset, not a paper describing this P300 dataset.
judgments.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
judgments.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software

judgments.reason: EEG-BIDS is a data-organization standard/specification used to format the dataset, not a paper describing the BNCI 2014-009 P300 recordings.
judgments.paper_title: EEG-BIDS, an extension to the brain imaging data structure for electroencephalography
